# Face fixtures

- `face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx`: YuNet, MIT, https://huggingface.co/opencv/face_detection_yunet. Models aren't bundled with the app (spec 032); this one is small enough to test real detection on every run.
- `astronaut.jpg`: Eileen Collins, NASA photo S95-00757, public domain, by way of scikit-image.
